about: Founder-maintained editorial list: which player to feature for a team in caption highlights. Prominence is an editorial judgement the model data does not encode, so only entries approved by the founder are used. A listed player is featured only when he appears in that game's published projections with valid medians and no injury flag; otherwise the deterministic fallback (most published expected minutes, no injury flag) is used and the reason is shown in the Command Center. Caption highlights are not a model ranking.
